hooks.name: spec-sync
hooks.description: When the agent finishes, remind it to tick completed tasks and log Kiro usage.

action.prompt: Before ending: (1) If you completed any task or sub-task from .kiro/specs/rakan-ulangkaji-mvp/tasks.md, change its checkbox from [ ] to [x]. Do not tick anything that is not done and verified. (2) Append a short entry to docs/kiro-usage-log.md using the template at the end of that file: date, Kiro feature, prompt summary, outcome, files touched. Keep the entry in plain English with no em dashes. If nothing relevant changed, say so and stop.
